name: Dongmin Go
headline: Wearable Robotics Software Engineer, HUROTICS
profile_affiliation: M.S. in Mechanical Engineering, Chung-Ang University
summary: I work as a wearable robotics software engineer at HUROTICS. I earned my M.S. in Mechanical Engineering from Chung-Ang University, where I conducted research in the Assistive and Rehabilitation Robotics Lab under the supervision of Prof. Giuk Lee.
homepage_interest_statement: I am particularly interested in human-robot interaction, reinforcement learning in simulation, and robot control.
homepage_goal_statement: My goal is to contribute to the development of companion robots that interact naturally and reliably with people in everyday life.
background: Previously, I worked as an Equipment Engineer in the Memory Business of Samsung Electronics' Device Solutions (DS) Division, responsible for EUV lithography equipment. I also received my B.S. in Mechanical Engineering from Chung-Ang University.
